visual_action: The video opens with a shot of Donald Trump and two other men in suits walking on a path on the White House grounds. The video then cuts to an interior shot of the Oval Office, where Donald Trump is seated at the Resolute Desk. A line of young men, who appear to be college athletes, walk up one by one to shake his hand. On the desk in front of Trump is a red football jersey with the name "TRUMP" and the number "47" on the back, an Indiana University football helmet, and a large silver championship trophy.
